description: Submit a career site application: creates the candidate and runs the pipeline automation.

answers.description: One item per question. IDs from hires_get_form(job form_id). Boolean: true/false, date: MM-DD-YYYY, time: 9:05 AM, dropdown: option text or an array of them

linkedin_url.description: Saved as the answer to the form's Linkedin URL question; not saved when the form has no such question

source.description: Name of an existing company source from hires_list_sources, attached to the candidate. An unknown name returns 400. Default: Career site

name: hires_submit_career_application
